title: A polynomial ring over a Nagata ring is Nagata
statement: Let $R$ be a Nagata ring [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring]. Then its polynomial ring $R[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] is Nagata.

proof.text: The Nagata hypothesis makes R Noetherian, hence R[X] is Noetherian by the finite type Noetherian theorem (Hilbert basis theorem).

For a prime q in R[X], contract it to p in R. The quotient R/p is Nagata by finiteness over R. The canonical map R/p -> R[X]/q is injective. Its target is generated by the image of X: every polynomial is a sum of monomials, and each monomial is a product of an image of a scalar and a power of that image of X. Apply the monogenic-domain N-2 theorem. Every prime quotient is therefore N-2, which together with Noetherianity proves the Nagata condition.
